The Hunt

The Old Kaiba Deck I’m Chasing

This is the one I’ve been after. Starter Deck: Kaiba Evolution — dropped March 1, 2004, the follow-up to the very first 2002 Starter Deck: Kaiba. 50 cards in the box, Kaiser Sea Horse on the cover, and inside: Blue-Eyes White Dragon — SKE-001, Super Rare, ATK 3000 / DEF 2500. That’s the card I want.

Quick note so it doesn’t fool anybody — the “1996” in the eBay listing title isn’t when this deck came out. That’s just the ©1996 Kazuki Takahashi copyright printed on the cards. The deck itself is 2004.

Still the highest bidder on eBay — $40 · ~2 days left · ends Mon Nov 23 at 8pm

Target No. 1 · The CREGiT Spirra

The Hunt

A yellow, black-striped Spirra with 1,538 km, sitting in Daegu. It's the only CREGiT ever built, with 470 hp.

This store exists to bring it home to Houston. Every order gets it closer.

Watch the hunt ↗

The Car: Why a Spirra?

The Spirra started life as the PS-II, a concept from Proto Motors, a small Korean sports-car maker. Oullim Motors took it into production as the Spirra and built it by hand, in tiny numbers.

Only 31 were ever made, from the naturally aspirated N to the twin-turbo EX, plus one CREGiT.

  • Spirra NNaturally aspirated~175 hp
  • Spirra SSmall single turbo~330 hp
  • Spirra TBigger turbo~420 hp
  • Spirra EXTwin turbo~500 hp
  • CREGiT1 of 1470 hp

31 made in total.
